title.zh: 百年时间博物馆：可核验、可纠错、无屏可达的城市时间教育线
title.en: Century-Time Museum: A Verifiable, Correctable, Screen-free Urban Time Education Line

purpose: Organize the existing twin-track narrative, source rights, failure archive and non-AI parity into one readable cultural contract: a century timeline that juxtaposes Jing-Zhang railway surveying, standards, signalling and maintenance with AI training, validation, failure, correction and retirement; every historical fact, archive reference, generated content item and future oral-history contract states its source type, version, permitted use, supported claim and what it cannot prove. No geometry, scene ID, project ID, maturity gate, rights status, approval or operating claim is changed.

inheritance.frontend: Twin-track Jing-Zhang continuous civic track, intermittent proof track, failure siding, and civic timetable
backend: three-carrier failure writeback and active retirement
urban-metabolism whole-system accounting and exit destinations
not_rebuilt: SCENE-004 failure and correction public archive

correctable_chronology.contract: Every timeline object is an evidence anchor, not a museum label. Each object states source_type, version, permitted_use, supported_claim and cannot_prove. Objects without an in-package cleared archive remain typed as public_reporting_pending_archive and must not be promoted to official chronology, heritage grade or construction record.

objects.event_zh: 京张铁路勘测与建设时期（詹天佑主持，含关沟段展线等工程组织）
objects.event_en: Jing-Zhang Railway survey and construction period, directed by Zhan Tianyou, including the Guanggou section switchback alignment
objects.permitted_use: 概念性文化叙事引用，仅用于说明铁路工程组织与公共记忆并置
objects.supported_claim: 京张铁路建设属于广泛公开的近代工程史议题，可作为时间教育线起点
objects.cannot_prove: 精确工期、展线几何、文物等级、官方定性或馆藏档案原文

objects.event_zh: 京张铁路全线通车（公开史实，档案原件待馆藏复核）
objects.event_en: Jing-Zhang Railway full-line opening (publicly documented; archival originals pending archive verification)
objects.permitted_use: 概念性文化叙事引用，不用于精确纪念日或官方定性
objects.supported_claim: 京张铁路通车属于公开史实，可作为时间刻度
objects.cannot_prove: 精确通车日期、首班记录、官方名录或纪念日法定地位

objects.event_zh: 京张高铁开通（公开报道）
objects.supported_claim: 京张通道在当代仍承担高铁运输功能
objects.cannot_prove: 运量、班次、设施清单或运营绩效

objects.event_zh: 京张铁路遗址公园分期开放（已有包内来源）
objects.event_en: Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park phased opening (in-package source)
objects.permitted_use: 包内已登记来源允许的公开基线引用
objects.supported_claim: 公园通过铁路遗存、绿色公共空间与功能织补连接高校、科研和居民生活
objects.cannot_prove: 开放时窗、设施清单、运营主体或后续建设承诺

objects.event_zh: AI 训练—验证—失败—纠错—退役与 G0-G3 门级对照（机制性表达）
objects.event_en: AI train-validate-fail-correct-retire against G0-G3 gates (mechanism-level expression)
objects.permitted_use: 对照图谱的机制侧；不指向任何具体产品或厂商
objects.supported_claim: AI 服务可用与铁路信号相似的门级、停止与恢复纪律组织
objects.cannot_prove: 任何具体 AI 系统的运行表现、失败案例或监管结论

railway_reliability_vs_ai_gate_parallel.contract: A teaching comparison, not an equivalence claim. Each row pairs a railway reliability practice with an AI lifecycle gate of the same discipline, and states what the pairing does and does not prove.

rows.ai_side: 证据门与来源等级先行
rows.teaches: 工程与 AI 服务都以可核验输入为起点
rows.cannot_prove: 两者风险相同或监管口径相同

rows.teaches: 失败可以公开、可停止、可恢复
rows.cannot_prove: AI 故障与铁路信号故障后果相当

rows.ai_side: 年度证据更新与内容退役
rows.teaches: 可靠性来自持续记录而非一次性建成
rows.cannot_prove: 任何设施或系统的实际维护绩效

grades.note: 当前包内无此类来源，全部相关主张保持待核验

grades.permitted_use: 包内登记允许用途内的公开基线引用
概念时间刻度引用，须标注待档案复核
grades.note: 不用于精确纪念日、官方定性或文物等级

grades.zh: 广泛公开史实（档案待复核）
grades.note: 如京张铁路建设与通车属于公开史实，但本包无清权档案

grades.permitted_use: 背景空间关系，须保持 ODbL 署名与 share-alike 义务

grades.note: 不伪造访谈，不收集多余个人信息

oral_history_consent_contract.contract: Future oral-history collection requires informed consent and withdrawal, both available on the same task without account or QR code. Until a real responsible operator, consent form, storage term and deletion procedure are confirmed, no interview is collected and no narrative is written as community memory.
consent_template_points: 采集目的、存储期限、公开范围与撤回方式以人工纸质或语音说明为准
同意与撤回均无需注册、扫码或使用 AI
个人敏感信息不进入公开档案
撤回后 30 个自然日内停止使用并从公开侧移除（待现实责任主体确认后生效）
oral_history_consent_contract.withdrawal: 同意可随时撤回；撤回后内容从公开侧下架，版本保留仅限内部最小化存证
oral_history_consent_contract.cannot_prove: 任何社区记忆的真实存在、人数或代表性

dispute_correction_flow.contract: Stop-takedown-correct-retain-recover flow for disputed cultural content. Roles without a confirmed real operator are written as role_pending and must not be filled with guessed institutions.

flow.zh: 停止：争议或错误内容立即停止对外展示，普通路径与人工服务不受影响
下架：内容从公开界面移除，保留版本记录（最小化内部存证）
纠错：以更高来源等级证据替换；无法核实时保持下架而非猜测
版本保留：旧版本以只读记录保留，标注原因、时间与处理者角色类型
恢复：仅经独立复核与公众说明后恢复；否则保持下架或主动退役

dispute_correction_flow.annual_retirement: 年度证据更新时，superseded 或 unavailable 的来源触发下游图文回退检查；无法回退的内容进入退役清单而非自动删除档案
dispute_correction_flow.cannot_prove: 任何真实争议事件、处理时长或投诉数量

screenless_journey.contract: A complete cultural journey usable without account, QR code, screen or AI: resident, student, commuter, visitor, international visitor, accessibility participant and staff roles each keep a non-AI path with human handoff, stop and recovery.

nodes.zh: 失败侧线展陈：停止/下架/纠错/恢复流程说明

field_unknowns: 官方/馆藏京张铁路史实档案（时间、人物、展线、文物等级）
京张高铁与遗址公园的官方开放时窗、设施与运营主体
责任主体：策展、独立复核、口述史采集、纠错处理均为角色待确认
生成内容标识的现实执行与监管口径

不得虚构精确日期、纪念日、文物等级、监管结论或运营成效
